prompt:
VCF Automation 9.0 integration task. VCF Automation is the successor to vRealize Automation and VMware Aria Automation. This repository contains a companion PowerShell module for the installed VMware.Sdk.Vcf PowerCLI modules. The manifest already declares VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager as a prerequisite; keep that declaration and do not vendor, download, or install PowerCLI modules in the repository.

Before editing code, use genuine web research to read the version-specific VCF 9.0 xAPIs reference pages at developer.broadcom.com for Create Integration Async, Get Request Tracker, and Retrieve Auth Token. These pages retain some legacy Aria Automation naming. Only Broadcom's official developer site counts as a source. Cite the exact official URLs you read in your final response. The pinned docs/contract.json was derived from those pages because VCF Automation has no published specification in vmware/vcf-api-specs; docs/official_sources.json records the provenance. Both files are protected. If the live pages disagree with the pinned contract, report the difference but do not change the protected fixtures.

Implement New-VcfAutomationIntegration in VcfAutomation.Integrations/VcfAutomation.Integrations.psm1. It must accept Server, AccessToken, ApiVersion, Name, IntegrationType, IntegrationProperties, optional Description, optional ValidateOnly, and PollIntervalMilliseconds. Send the documented POST /iaas/api/integrations request with Bearer authentication and JSON, using the caller's ApiVersion query value. Include Description or validateOnly only when the caller actually supplied the corresponding parameter; unset optional request fields must be omitted, not serialized as empty strings, nulls, false values, or empty collections.

The POST is asynchronous. Take its request-tracker id and poll GET /iaas/api/request-tracker/{id}, with the same apiVersion and authentication, until the documented status is terminal. Do not treat the POST response as completion. Return the FINISHED tracker. On FAILED, stop immediately and throw an error that identifies the request and includes its server message. Sleep PollIntervalMilliseconds only between INPROGRESS polls. Do not add a maximum-attempt or timeout parameter. Reject an unrecognized status as a malformed service response.

Acceptance: python3 tests/verify.py. The protected verifier starts the protected contract-pinned mock only on loopback, reads its request log, and checks the exact method, path, query, headers, body, omission of unset optionals, polling sequence, and FAILED behavior. It never contacts a live VMware endpoint. Do not modify VcfAutomation.Integrations/VcfAutomation.Integrations.psd1, tests/, or docs/.
